title: Foreword: Pre-Generation Prediction and Characterisation of LLM Test Failures using the Jacobian Lens
title_zh: Foreword：基于Jacobian透镜的大模型测试失败的生成前预测与刻画

paragraphs.en: Testing LLM-based software is expensive: each input needs several sampled responses, each judged by a costly oracle. Further, every prompt or model change calls for re-testing. Pre-generation adequacy measures cut this cost by ranking inputs by failure risk based on the model’s internal state. However, the state of the art, Clotho, models only passing reference inputs, and its hidden-state representation says nothing about why inputs fail. We present Foreword , a framework built on two ideas: learn from both passing and failing references, and represent inputs through the Jacobian lens (J-lens), an interpretability technique that reads intermediate activations out as scores over vocabulary tokens. Foreword pairs these representations with two estimators: a sparse logistic-regression probe or dual Gaussian Mixture Models (dual GMMs), which also yield a reference density (to flag inputs the references do not cover) and failing-class components (to group similar failures). On ten tasks and three open-weight LLMs, all four combinations of representations and estimators outperform Clotho on average, both for prediction of failure (ROC-AUC improves by 0.14 on average and by up to 0.31) and test prioritisation (15% more failures among the 100 top-ranked inputs on average, up to 33%). Prioritisation obtained using small models also transfers better to proprietary models (on average 22% and up to 41% more failures in the first quarter of prioritised inputs). Importantly, our qualitative case study shows that Foreword supports semantic characterisation of failures by pointing to ambiguities in labels or task specifications. Combined, Foreword can support testers for prioritising inputs, checking support for a prediction, and characterising specific failures, all without generating output.
paragraphs.zh: 测试基于大语言模型的软件成本高昂：每个输入都需要多次采样响应，且每次都要由昂贵的判定器（oracle）进行评判。 此外，每一次提示或模型变更都需要重新测试。 预生成充分性度量通过基于模型内部状态对输入按失败风险进行排序，从而削减了这一成本。 然而，现有最先进的方法 Clotho 只对通过的参考输入建模，且其隐状态表示无法说明输入为何失败。 我们提出 Foreword，一个建立在两个思想之上的框架：同时从通过与失败的参考中学习，并通过雅可比透镜（J-lens）表示输入，这是一种可解释性技术，可将中间激活读取为词表 token 上的分数。 Foreword 将这些表示与两种估计器配对：稀疏逻辑回归探针或双高斯混合模型（dual GMMs），后者还能提供参考密度（用于标记参考未覆盖的输入）和失败类分量（用于归类相似的失败）。 在十个任务和三个开放权重大语言模型上，表示与估计器的全部四种组合平均而言都优于 Clotho，无论是在失败预测方面（ROC-AUC 平均提升 0.14，最高提升 0.31），还是在测试优先级排序方面（排名前 100 的输入中失败数量平均多 15%，最多多 33%）。 使用小模型获得的优先级排序也能更好地迁移到专有模型上（在排序后第一四分位的输入中，失败数量平均多 22%，最多多 41%）。 重要的是，我们的定性案例研究表明，Foreword 能够通过指出标签或任务规范中的歧义，支持对失败进行语义刻画。 综合而言，Foreword 可以在不生成输出的情况下，帮助测试人员对输入进行优先级排序、检验预测的支持度，并刻画具体的失败。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) now power software in a growing number of domains, from education [ 7 ] and health care [ 26 ] to software development itself [ 1 ] . Such software must be tested thoroughly, but LLM testing is expensive. LLMs can react to the same input differently each time, so a reliable aggregate verdict on one input may take several iterations, each judged by an oracle that is sometimes itself an LLM [ 28 ] . Every change to a prompt, model, or configuration can also require testing again. Testers would therefore like to predict which inputs are likely to fail, understand what failing inputs have in common, and assess when such predictions are supported. Shared failure patterns could help guide fixes and help choose tests that cover different kinds of failure. Yet current LLM testing tools give little guidance even on which inputs to run first [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）如今正为越来越多领域的软件提供支持，从教育 [ 7 ] 和医疗保健 [ 26 ] 到软件开发本身 [ 1 ] 。 此类软件必须经过彻底测试，但LLM测试成本高昂。 LLM每次对同一输入的反应都可能不同，因此要对单个输入得出可靠的综合判定，可能需要多轮迭代，每轮都由一个判定器（oracle）来评判，而该判定器有时本身就是LLM [ 28 ] 。 对提示词、模型或配置的每次更改也可能需要重新测试。 因此，测试人员希望预测哪些输入可能失败，理解失败输入的共同点，并评估这些预测何时有依据支撑。 共享的失败模式有助于指导修复，并有助于选择覆盖不同失败类型的测试。 然而，当前的LLM测试工具甚至对应该优先运行哪些输入也几乎没有提供指导 [ 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recently, Clotho [ 31 ] , a pre-generation test adequacy measure, was proposed to estimate the likelihood of failure before an output is generated. The key insight is that output uncertainty can be approximated from the LLM’s internal latent space: if a new input’s hidden-state representation is an outlier relative to inputs known to produce correct outputs, it is more likely to fail. Empirical results show that the ranking lets testers execute inputs likely to fail first, without generating any outputs for the remaining ones. However, Clotho neither characterises shared failure patterns nor distinguishes familiar failures from inputs unlike its references.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，Clotho [ 31 ] 作为一种生成前测试充分性度量被提出，用于在输出生成之前估计失败的可能性。 其关键洞察是，输出不确定性可以从大语言模型的内部潜在空间来近似：如果一个新输入的隐藏状态表示相对于已知能产生正确输出的输入而言是离群点，那么它更可能失败。 实验结果表明，该排序能让测试人员优先执行可能失败的输入，而无需为其余输入生成任何输出。 然而，Clotho 既不能刻画共同的失败模式，也无法将其已知引用中相似的失败与不同于引用的输入区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We present Foreword , a framework that extends Clotho in two ways: (1) learning from both passing and failing reference inputs, and (2) representing inputs through readouts from the Jacobian lens (J-lens), a mechanistic interpretability technique [ 16 ] . Learning from both outcomes allows us to fit a predictor that distinguishes passing from failing inputs. The J-lens expresses intermediate LLM activations as vocabulary-token scores that reveal concepts the model has available for verbalisation. Unlike Clotho’s opaque hidden-state vectors, these scores correspond to readable tokens, offering a basis for describing individual inputs and groups of failures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Foreword，一个从两个方面扩展 Clotho 的框架：(1) 同时从通过和失败的参考输入中学习，以及 (2) 通过 Jacobian 透镜（J-lens）的读出来表征输入，这是一种机制可解释性技术 [ 16 ]。 同时从两种结果中学习使我们能够拟合一个区分通过输入和失败输入的预测器。 J-lens 将大语言模型的中间激活表达为词表 token 分数，这些分数揭示了模型可用于言语化的概念。 与 Clotho 不透明的隐藏状态向量不同，这些分数对应于可读的 token，为描述单个输入和失败组提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Foreword represents inputs through vocabulary-aligned J-lens Readout Scores (JRS) and supports two failure estimators that learn from both passing and failing reference inputs. The dual Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) estimator extends Clotho by fitting separate distributions to passing and failing references. Together, the two GMMs yield a failure score, a reference-density signal for flagging weakly supported inputs, and component groups whose token profiles can be inspected separately. Alternatively, a simpler Logistic Regression (LR) estimator can learn the boundary between passing and failing inputs focusing more directly on failure prediction.

paragraphs.en: Across ten tasks, including two Python program-synthesis benchmarks with executable tests, our evaluation of Foreword separates representation choice from estimator choice by pairing both estimators with JRS and Clotho’s Last-token Input Hidden States (LIHS). All four configurations improve average ROC-AUC over Clotho; LR performs best overall. J-lens features provide readable token profiles with similar average discrimination to LIHS, although differences vary by task. In our topic-classification case study, component profiles describe separate failure groups, whereas the inspected global LR weight rankings mix several concepts.

paragraphs.en: Test adequacy measures how well a given test input, or a set of inputs, checks the target System Under Test (SUT). A good adequacy metric is expected to be correlated with fault detection capability: an input with a higher adequacy value should be more likely to reveal unexpected behaviour. Such metrics can be used to assess the quality of existing test inputs [ 34 ] , or to prioritise inputs with the aim of revealing unexpected behaviour as early as possible [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 测试充分性衡量给定的测试输入或一组输入对被测系统（SUT）目标的检查程度。 一个好的充分性度量应当与故障检测能力相关：充分性值较高的输入应更有可能揭示意外行为。 这类度量可用于评估现有测试输入的质量 [ 34 ] ，或用于对输入进行优先级排序，以尽早揭示意外行为 [ 12 ] 。

sents.en: Such metrics can be used to assess the quality of existing test inputs [ 34 ] , or to prioritise inputs with the aim of revealing unexpected behaviour as early as possible [ 12 ] .
sents.zh: 这类度量可用于评估现有测试输入的质量 [ 34 ] ，或用于对输入进行优先级排序，以尽早揭示意外行为 [ 12 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Test adequacy is crucial for efficient testing of LLM-based systems, as their test oracles tend to be expensive, be it human judgement or LLM-as-judges [ 28 ] . A reliable test adequacy metric will prioritise inputs according to their likelihood of failing (i.e., producing undesired responses), allowing the test efforts to be focused on those problematic inputs. However, many of the traditional adequacy criteria are white-box, code-based metrics, such as structural coverage [ 34 ] . Consequently, they do not directly apply to Large Language Models (LLMs) that are generative models with no interpretable structural units.
paragraphs.zh: 测试充分性对于基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统的高效测试至关重要，因为其测试预言机往往代价高昂，无论是人工判断还是以 LLM 作为评判者 [ 28 ]。 一个可靠的测试充分性度量将根据输入失败（即产生不符合预期的响应）的可能性对其进行优先级排序，从而使测试工作能够聚焦于那些有问题的输入。 然而，许多传统的充分性准则是白盒的、基于代码的度量，例如结构覆盖率 [ 34 ]。 因此，它们并不直接适用于大语言模型（LLM），因为 LLM 是没有可解释结构单元的生成式模型。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the high oracle cost, confidence metrics have been widely adopted. If the LLM response to a given test input has low confidence, it is more likely that the response is not correct. Various confidence metrics have been studied in this context, including token-level likelihood and entropy [ 20 ] , and the semantic-level entropy [ 13 ] . While the uncertainty measures can be used to prioritise test inputs, their common limitation is that uncertainty becomes available only after the full response generation, highlighting the fact that it is a metric for outputs, not inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解高昂的预言机成本，置信度指标已被广泛采用。 如果大语言模型对给定测试输入的响应置信度较低，则该响应不正确的可能性更大。 在此背景下，已有多种置信度指标得到研究，包括词元级似然与熵 [ 20 ]，以及语义级熵 [ 13 ]。 虽然不确定性度量可用于对测试输入进行优先级排序，但它们的共同局限在于不确定性只有在完整响应生成之后才可获得，这凸显了一个事实：它是一种针对输出的度量，而非针对输入的度量。

paragraphs.en: Clotho is a recently proposed pre-generation test adequacy metric [ 31 ] . It approximates the uncertainty with out-of-distribution measures at pre-generation stage: the reference distribution is obtained by fitting a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) using a reference set of passing input with respect to a specific task, iteratively sampled with user labelling. The test adequacy value of an unseen input is the negative log likelihood given by the trained GMM. Since the GMM is fitted with passing inputs, the adequacy score is correlated to the likelihood of the input generating correct output, and therefore can be used to prioritise inputs. Notably, Clotho computes its test adequacy pre-generation, based on the Last-token Input Hidden State (LIHS), i.e., the hidden state of the last input token at a layer two thirds of the way through the Transformer decoder. This representation is known to contain rich semantic information about the given context [ 6 , 33 ] .

paragraphs.en: Hidden states such as LIHS are informative but not human-readable. Lens techniques address this by decoding intermediate activations into the model’s vocabulary. In a decoder-only Transformer, each layer reads from and writes to a residual stream, whose value after layer ℓ \ell at token position p p we denote a ℓ , p a_{\ell,p} . After the last layer, a final normalisation ( norm \operatorname{norm} ) and the unembedding matrix ( W U W_{U} ) convert the residual stream into next-token logits. The logit lens [ 23 ] applies norm \operatorname{norm} and W U W_{U} directly to intermediate activations. However, this assumes that intermediate layers encode information in the same way as the final layer, which holds only for the last few layers.
paragraphs.zh: 像 LIHS 这样的隐藏状态富含信息，但不具备人类可读性。 Lens 技术通过将中间激活解码到模型的词表中来解决这一问题。 在仅解码器（decoder-only）的 Transformer 中，每一层都从残差流中读取并向其写入，我们将第 ℓ \ell 层在标记位置 p p 处的残差流取值记为 a ℓ , p a_{\ell,p} 。 在最后一层之后，最终归一化（ norm \operatorname{norm} ）和反嵌入矩阵（ W U W_{U} ）将残差流转换为下一个标记的 logits。 logit lens 方法 [ 23 ] 直接对中间激活应用 norm \operatorname{norm} 和 W U W_{U} 。 然而，这假设中间层以与最终层相同的方式编码信息，而这一假设仅在最后几层成立。

paragraphs.en: The Jacobian lens (J-lens) [ 16 ] addresses this by first mapping activations into the final layer’s representation space, using the average Jacobian J ℓ = 𝔼 x , p , p ′ ≥ p ​ [ ∂ a final , p ′ ​ ( x ) / ∂ a ℓ , p ​ ( x ) ] J_{\ell}=\mathbb{E}_{x,p,p^{\prime}\geq p}[\partial a_{\mathrm{final},p^{\prime}}(x)/\partial a_{\ell,p}(x)] , where x x ranges over prompts from a generic text corpus, p p over source positions, and p ′ p^{\prime} over the current and all later positions. paragraphs.en: Foreword is a framework for pre-generation input adequacy: it supports two input representations, and two adequacy estimators. In addition to the Last-token Input Hidden States (LIHS) of Clotho, Foreword can also represent inputs using J-lens readouts [ 16 ] , which capture what the model is poised to verbalise. For estimators, Foreword supports Logistic Regression to predict pass or fail outcome of the output to be generated from the given input. Further, unlike Clotho, Foreword also learns from failing inputs, so that familiar failure patterns can be recognised, using dual GMM.

paragraphs.en: Given a target model, a task-specific prompt template T T , and a candidate pool 𝒫 \mathcal{P} , we extract a representation h ⁡ ( x ) = ϕ ⁡ ( T ⁡ ( x ) ) h(x)=\phi(T(x)) for each input x x without decoding a response. To label an input, we sample 10 responses and use a task-specific oracle to compute u ⁡ ( x ) u(x) , the fraction judged correct. We assign y ⁡ ( x ) = pass y(x)=\mathrm{pass} if a strict majority of the responses are correct and y ⁡ ( x ) = fail y(x)=\mathrm{fail} otherwise. The labelled inputs form the reference set ℛ t \mathcal{R}_{t} at acquisition round t t , with passing and failing subsets ℛ t , P \mathcal{R}_{t,P} and ℛ t , F \mathcal{R}_{t,F} . Once fitted on ℛ t \mathcal{R}_{t} , the estimators score new inputs from h ⁡ ( x ) h(x) alone. paragraphs.en: The second estimator is dual Gaussian Mixture Models (dual GMMs), which is an extension of the GMM used by Clotho. The motivation for dual GMM is two-fold. First, the LR probe models only the boundary between the classes, pass and fail, but not how each class is distributed, providing no measure of how well the references support an input. Second, by modelling supports for both passing and failing inputs (hence the duality), Foreword aims to identify groups of similar failures.

paragraphs.en: The dual GMM projects the representations into a shared PCA space and fits a separate GMM to each outcome class. Together, the two class models yield three outputs: a posterior failure score comparable to that of the LR probe, a reference density that identifies inputs weakly supported by the references, and component memberships that group inputs within each class and provide a basis for investigating recurring failure patterns. We first define these outputs and then describe how the model configuration adapts as the reference set grows.

paragraphs.en: As in Clotho [ 31 ] , we adapt the configuration of the dual GMM as the reference set grows, since the appropriate model complexity depends on both the task and the number of available references. The configuration consists of the shared PCA dimensionality D t D_{t} and, for each class c c , the number of mixture components and the covariance structure, θ t , c \theta_{t,c} . Searching over all combinations of these settings would require fitting many pairs of class models at every refit. paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 constructs the reference set iteratively, refitting the estimator as new labels are acquired. We present it for the dual GMM and describe the LR variant at the end of this section. Given the candidate pool 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and a labelling budget N N , the algorithm first constructs and caches the representations of all candidates (line 1 ). It then labels N 0 N_{0} randomly selected inputs as the initial references and initialises the unlabelled pool (lines 1 – 1 ). At each round t t , it partitions the references by outcome (line 1 ). Once both classes contain at least m min m_{\min} references, it selects the PCA transformation and the class-specific mixture configurations θ t , P \theta_{t,P} and θ t , F \theta_{t,F} as described in Section 3.3 (line 1 ), estimates the class priors, and fits the class models ℳ t , P \mathcal{M}_{t,P} and ℳ t , F \mathcal{M}_{t,F} (lines 1 – 1 ). Otherwise, no fitted scorer is available (line 1 ). The stopping check follows this fit: if the budget is exhausted or the unlabelled pool is empty, the algorithm returns the scorer fitted on the current reference set, or ⊥ \bot if either class still lacks m min m_{\min} references (line 1 ). If acquisition continues, the next batch size B t B_{t} is limited by the remaining budget and pool size (line 1 ). When the scorer is available, ⌈ B t / 2 ⌉ \lceil B_{t}/2\rceil inputs are selected by the model-based acquisition criterion Margin (lines 1 – 1 ), which ranks unlabelled inputs by the binary entropy H ​ ( s G , t ​ ( x ) ) H(s_{\mathrm{G},t}(x)) of their posterior failure scores, favouring inputs near the fitted pass/fail boundary. Diversity sampling fills the remaining positions by repeatedly choosing the input with the greatest minimum Euclidean distance in h h -space from the references and inputs already selected for this batch (lines 1 – 1 ). If the scorer is unavailable, diversity sampling selects the entire batch (line 1 ). The batch is then labelled, added to the references, and removed from the unlabelled pool before the next round (lines 1 – 1 ). The LR variant uses the same acquisition loop. Lines 1 – 1 instead fit the probe defined in Section 3.2 to ℛ t \mathcal{R}_{t} , and Margin uses s L , t s_{\mathrm{L},t} in place of s G , t s_{\mathrm{G},t} .

paragraphs.en: This section details the experimental setup used to evaluate Foreword .

paragraphs.en: We organise the study around the following research questions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕以下研究问题来组织本研究。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each method on held-out inputs drawn from the same task. This assesses whether pre-generation scores separate failure-inducing inputs from passing ones, and whether ranking inputs by predicted failure risks enables earlier failure discovery under limited execution budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在从同一任务中抽取的留出输入上评估每种方法。 这评估了预生成分数能否将导致失败的输入与通过的输入区分开来，以及通过按预测失败风险对输入排序，能否在有限的执行预算下更早地发现失败。

paragraphs.en: We compare Foreword with the pre-generation baseline Clotho [ 31 ] and three post-generation adequacy metrics: Token Probability (TOK prob ) and Token Entropy (TOK ent ) [ 20 ] , and Last Output-token Hidden State Variance (LOHS var ). We compare Foreword to all the above for evaluation of failure prediction, and only to pre-generation methods as well as random for evaluation of prioritisation. We study the 2 by 2 combinations of representations (LIHS and JRS) and estimators (LR and dual GMM) to separate their contributions.

paragraphs.en: As JRS is tied to specific tokens, we can represent observed failure patterns as tokens. This is more straightforward with failure components of dual GMM: we can pool all inputs belonging to each failure component, and apply J-lens to read the tokens. LR, on the other hand, simply fits a hyperplane in the JRS space which best separates passing and failing input representations. Consequently, we can read out the tokens that have the highest influence on the separation from the normalised weights of the fitted LR models. We qualitatively analyse whether such readouts can characterise different groups of failures taken from TOPIC-CLS and MBPP tasks using Llama-3.1-8B.

paragraphs.en: On TOPIC-CLS , we examine the failing-class GMM components through two complementary analyses. First, we assess whether they show distinctive failure patterns, characterised by each input’s ground truth topic and the predicted topic. Second, we examine whether the tokens we read out of the failing input representation reveal semantic characteristics of the failure pattern. paragraphs.en: Foreword requires hidden states, which are not available from proprietary models and expensive to extract from larger open-weight models. Clotho showed that pass-only scores from smaller open-weight models transfer to proprietary models [ 31 ] ; we ask whether better modelling of failures in smaller models can improve these transfers. To test this, we fit estimators using source representations from smaller models, and use target outcomes to evaluate the orderings obtained using the estimator scores (see Section 4.2.2 for model pairs).
paragraphs.zh: 前向过程需要隐藏状态，而这些状态在专有模型中不可获取，且从更大的开源权重模型中提取代价高昂。 Clotho 证明了来自较小开源权重模型的仅通过分数可以迁移到专有模型 [ 31 ]；我们探究对较小模型中失败的更好建模能否改善这些迁移。 为测试这一点，我们使用较小模型的源表示拟合估计器，并用目标结果来评估基于估计器分数得到的排序（模型对见第 4.2.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Following Clotho, we use a fixed random subset of 2,000 inputs per task, or all non-training inputs for the smaller MBPP and LCB datasets. paragraphs.en: We implement the logistic regression probe and the density estimators using LogisticRegression from sklearn.linear_model and GaussianMixture from sklearn.mixture , respectively [ 25 ] . For logistic regression, we use the liblinear solver. We tune the inverse regularisation strength C C by cross-validation, choosing the value with the highest AUROC among ten values between 10 − 2 10^{-2} and 10 10 . When there are too few references for cross-validation, we set C = 1 C=1 . For density estimation, separate GMMs are fitted to the passing and failing references in a shared PCA space, and their configuration is selected adaptively as described in Section 3.3.2 . We restrict the PCA dimensionality to the range of 10 to 50. When cross-validation scores are unavailable for a class, we select its number of components using the Bayesian information criterion (BIC) instead. Expectation–maximisation terminates when the change in the average log-likelihood lower bound falls below 10 − 3 10^{-3} or after 200 iterations, whichever occurs first.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别使用 sklearn.linear_model 中的 LogisticRegression 和 sklearn.mixture 中的 GaussianMixture 来实现逻辑回归探针和密度估计器 [25]。 对于逻辑回归，我们使用 liblinear 求解器。 我们通过交叉验证调整逆正则化强度 C C，在 10 − 2 10^{-2} 到 10 10 之间的十个值中选择 AUROC 最高的那个。 当参考样本太少而无法进行交叉验证时，我们将 C 设为 1 C=1。 对于密度估计，我们在一个共享的 PCA 空间中分别对通过和未通过的参考样本拟合不同的 GMM，并按照第 3.3.2 节所述自适应地选择其配置。 我们将 PCA 维度限制在 10 到 50 的范围内。 当某个类别的交叉验证分数不可用时，我们改用贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）来选择其分量数量。 当平均对数似然下界的变化低于 10 − 3 10^{-3} 或达到 200 次迭代时（以先发生者为准），期望最大化算法终止。

paragraphs.en: To construct JRS, we extract representations at the model-specific assistant-header position immediately preceding response generation, and average per-layer-standardised Jacobian-lens readouts over a mid-to-late workspace band: layers 14–28 of 32 for Llama-3.1-8B, 18–37 of 42 for Gemma-2-9B, and 16–32 of 36 for Qwen3-8B (0-indexed, inclusive).
paragraphs.zh: 为构建 JRS，我们在紧接响应生成之前的模型专属助手头部位置提取表示，并在中后期工作区层段上对逐层标准化的雅可比透镜读出取平均：对于 Llama-3.1-8B 为 32 层中的第 14–28 层，对于 Gemma-2-9B 为 42 层中的第 18–37 层，对于 Qwen3-8B 为 36 层中的第 16–32 层（索引从 0 开始，含两端）。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 reports ROC-AUC with 500 labelled references. All four configurations of Foreword separate failing from passing inputs better than Clotho: their mean ROC-AUC is 0.784 for LIHS DG , 0.791 for JRS DG , 0.839 for LIHS LR , and 0.837 for JRS LR , compared with 0.675 for Clotho. The improvement holds on every task: averaged over LLMs, each configuration exceeds Clotho on all ten tasks, and both LR configurations do so in all 30 task–LLM combinations. Part of this gain may reflect label usage: Clotho models only the passing-input distribution and discards the failing examples during label acquisition, whereas Foreword learns from both.

paragraphs.en: To assess estimator and representation effects, we use four paired contrasts: LR versus dual GMM within each representation, and JRS versus LIHS within each estimator. We treat tasks as the unit of inference, averaging each contrast over seeds and the three LLMs within a task. For the ten resulting differences, we report a Hodges–Lehmann (HL) estimate and 95% confidence interval, test against zero with a two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test, and apply Holm’s correction to the four p p -values for each metric. Estimator choice shows the clearer pattern. LR gains about 0.05 0.05 ROC-AUC over dual GMM with either representation (Holm-adjusted p ≤ 0.012 p\leq 0.012 ), leading on every task with LIHS and all but TOPIC-CLS with JRS. The JRS–LIHS contrasts are near zero (ROC-AUC + 0.003 0.003 ) under both estimators, with confidence intervals spanning zero; we find no clear overall representation advantage. On the two program-synthesis tasks, MBPP and LCB , LIHS LR achieves mean ROC-AUCs of 0.82 and 0.88, versus 0.80 and 0.78 for JRS LR and 0.63 and 0.71 for Clotho. JRS LR instead outperforms LIHS LR on TOPIC-CLS and POS-TAG , showing that the preferred representation varies by task.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估估计器与表征的影响，我们使用四组配对对比：在每种表征内比较 LR 与双 GMM，在每种估计器内比较 JRS 与 LIHS。 我们将任务作为推断的单位，在每个任务内对随机种子和三个 LLM 取平均值来计算每个对比。 对于由此得到的十个差异，我们报告 Hodges–Lehmann（HL）估计值和 95% 置信区间，用双侧精确 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 against 零假设，并对每个指标的四个 p 值应用 Holm 校正。 估计器的选择呈现出更清晰的模式。 在任一表征下，LR 的 ROC-AUC 都比双 GMM 高出约 0.05（Holm 校正后 p ≤ 0.012），在 LIHS 下的所有任务以及 JRS 下除 TOPIC-CLS 外的所有任务上均领先。 在两种估计器下，JRS 与 LIHS 的对比都接近于零（ROC-AUC +0.003），且置信区间均跨越零；我们没有发现表征存在明显的总体优势。 在两个程序合成任务 MBPP 和 LCB 上，LIHS LR 的平均 ROC-AUC 分别达到 0.82 和 0.88，而 JRS LR 分别为 0.80 和 0.78，Clotho 分别为 0.63 和 0.71。 相反，JRS LR 在 TOPIC-CLS 和 POS-TAG 上优于 LIHS LR，这表明首选的表征因任务而异。

paragraphs.en: Across every target–source pair, reference density achieves lower mean FPR95 and higher mean ROC-AUC than either LR-derived score (Table 5 ). Averaged over the four OOD sources, its FPR95 is 0.185 0.185 for JSON-FIX and 0.164 0.164 for TOPIC-CLS , compared with 0.879 0.879 and 0.639 0.639 for pass probability. At these thresholds, reference density retains 94.7 % 94.7\% and 95.2 % 95.2\% of held-out in-distribution inputs, close to the 95 % 95\% calibration target. The practical implication is clear. At thresholds that retain 95 % 95\% of ID inputs, LR pass probability accept most OOD inputs as in-distribution; maximum-softmax confidence accepts over 95 % 95\% of them for both targets. A high pass probability, or softmax confidence, therefore does not indicate that an input belongs to the reference task, and neither score can serve as a reliable OOD detection filter under this protocol.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 shows the true-topic (left) and predicted-topic (right) distributions of components F 0 F_{0} – F 3 F_{3} for seed 0, with the final column of each panel giving the pooled distribution across all four components. Read together, the panels show different failure patterns. Sci/Tech accounts for 73% of the failures in these sets and appears in several components, but the components’ true–predicted topic differ. F 2 F_{2} isolates a single Sci/Tech → \rightarrow Business confusion, whereas F 1 F_{1} gathers inputs from several true topics that the model mispredicts as World, and F 3 F_{3} concentrates on inputs mispredicted as Other. paragraphs.en: The value of J-lens readouts also extends to program synthesis. In Fig. 2(b) , on the MBPP task, F 0 F_{0} emphasises merging ( merge, combine ), while F 1 F_{1} emphasises circle geometry ( circumference, radius ). In the F 0 F_{0} case, the task asks for the three closest elements, one from each of three sorted arrays. All ten leading J-lens tokens concern merging or combining, but a majority of the responses merge the arrays without enforcing the one-per-array constraint; none passes. In the F 1 F_{1} case, the task asks for the perimeter of a cylinder. The benchmark expects the perimeter of its side-view rectangle, 2 ​ ( d + h ) 2(d+h) , but the task does not say so. The leading J-lens tokens are circle terms ( circumference, circle, radius ), with no rectangle term among them, and all ten responses build circle-based formulas with π \pi ; none passes. The readout and generated programs together suggest an alternative interpretation of an underspecified task.

paragraphs.en: These cases show how pre-generation readouts can help characterise failures and identify possible ambiguity in task specifications. The cylinder’s perimeter has no standard definition, making an alternative interpretation defensible. As with the golfer’s wedding in TOPIC-CLS , the readout and generated responses together help an analyst assess whether the failure reflects an LLM error or ambiguity in the task specification or ground-truth label. However, the readouts do not establish that the highlighted concepts caused the failures. A readout may also suggest an appropriate approach without revealing whether the generated program will implement it correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 这些案例表明，预生成读出（readout）如何帮助刻画失败情况并识别任务规范中可能存在的歧义。 圆柱体的周长没有标准定义，因此另一种解释也是说得通的。 与 TOPIC-CLS 中高尔夫球手的婚礼类似，读出与生成的回答共同帮助分析者判断该失败究竟反映了 LLM 的错误，还是任务规范或基准真值标签中的歧义。 然而，这些读出并不能证明被突出显示的概念就是导致失败的原因。 读出也可能只是提示了一种合适的方法，却无法揭示生成的程序是否会正确实现该方法。

paragraphs.en: The gains extend to all three proprietary targets. Claude Haiku 4.5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite pass most inputs, with mean pass rates of 0.857 and 0.860 across tasks. The larger open-weight targets also let us assess the role of model family. We compare each source’s lead over the other two sources on its own-family target with its lead on the other open-weight targets. Sharing a family gives an average advantage of about 0.02, much smaller than the LR probes’ gain over Clotho. It does not overcome source quality: Llama-3.1-8B is the weakest source in 22 of the 24 target–scorer combinations, including all four combinations in Llama-3.3-70B.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3(a) shows extraction time per input. J-lens takes 0.40 s per input on average, compared with 0.15 s for LIHS, or 2.7 times as long. This is expected, as LIHS is the hidden state read directly from the forward pass, whereas J-lens must further map that state into vocabulary space through the Jacobian lens [ 16 ] . Gemma, the largest of the three studied LLMs, is the slowest against both representations, yet J-lens extraction stays below half a second per input in every setting on a single consumer GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 图3(a)展示了每个输入的提取时间。 J-lens每个输入平均耗时0.40秒，而LIHS为0.15秒，即前者的耗时是后者的2.7倍。 这在预料之中，因为LIHS是直接从前向传播中读取的隐藏状态，而J-lens必须通过Jacobian透镜[16]将该状态进一步映射到词表空间。 在所研究的三个大语言模型中规模最大的Gemma，在两种表示下都是最慢的，但在单个消费级GPU上的所有设置中，J-lens的提取时间均保持在每个输入半秒以内。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3(b) shows the cumulative fitting time over the 500-label active-learning loop. Clotho is by far the slowest: fitting its passing-class GMM takes 874 s per run on average, about seven times the roughly two-minute average of the other four pairs. We attribute the difference mainly to how the covariance is modelled. Both GMM-based methods fit PCA-reduced features, but Clotho estimates a full covariance matrix for each mixture component, whereas the dual GMM usually falls back to diagonal covariance because each class has too few references to estimate a full one.
paragraphs.zh: 图3(b)展示了500标签主动学习循环中的累计拟合时间。 Clotho 是迄今最慢的：拟合其通过类 GMM 平均每次运行需要874秒，约为其他四个对约两分钟平均值的七倍。 我们将这一差异主要归因于协方差的建模方式。 两种基于 GMM 的方法都拟合经 PCA 降维的特征，但 Clotho 为每个混合分量估计完整协方差矩阵，而双 GMM 通常退回到对角协方差，因为每个类的参考样本太少，无法估计完整协方差。

paragraphs.en: Among these four pairs, the representation has a small, scorer-dependent effect: J-lens lowers the dual GMM’s average fitting time from 133 s to 113 s (15%) but raises the LR probe’s from 122 s to 131 s (7%). The scorer likewise has a small, representation-dependent effect: replacing the dual GMM with the LR probe lowers the average from 133 s to 122 s on LIHS (8%) but raises it from 113 s to 131 s on J-lens (16%). As a result, the dual GMM on J-lens is the cheapest of the five pairs on average. The two scorers have comparable costs even though a GMM is the more complex model, because both spend most of their time on hyperparameter search: the dual GMM runs about 500 small fits per iteration on PCA-reduced features, whereas the LR probe runs about 50 L1-regularised fits on all original feature space. This parity is specific to RQ1’s search configuration rather than a general property of GMMs versus logistic regression.
paragraphs.zh: 在这四对组合中，表示方式的影响较小且取决于评分器：J-lens 将双 GMM 的平均拟合时间从 133 秒降至 113 秒（15%），但将 LR 探针的从 122 秒升至 131 秒（7%）。 评分器的影响同样较小且取决于表示方式：将双 GMM 替换为 LR 探针，在 LIHS 上将平均值从 133 秒降至 122 秒（8%），但在 J-lens 上将其从 113 秒升至 131 秒（16%）。 因此，J-lens 上的双 GMM 是五对组合中平均成本最低的。 尽管双 GMM 是更复杂的模型，但两种评分器的成本相当，因为两者的大部分时间都花在超参数搜索上：双 GMM 每次迭代在 PCA 降维后的特征上运行约 500 次小规模拟合，而 LR 探针则在全部原始特征空间上运行约 50 次 L1 正则化拟合。 这种持平是 RQ1 搜索配置所特有的，而非 GMM 与逻辑回归之间的一般特性。

paragraphs.en: What J-lens contributes. Derived from the same forward pass as LIHS, JRS adds a readable basis for characterising failures rather than new information. Its comparable average discrimination suggests little predictive cost for this readability. Task differences remain: JRS LR leads on TOPIC-CLS and POS-TAG , while LIHS LR leads on MBPP and LCB . These differences may reflect how the corpus used to estimate the Jacobians and token selection shape the task-relevant information JRS retains. Varying this corpus, vocabulary size, and layer range could assess sensitivity to these choices.
paragraphs.zh: J-lens 的贡献。 JRS 与 LIHS 出自同一次前向传播，它为刻画失败提供了可读的基础，而非新的信息。 其相当的平均区分度表明，这种可读性几乎不带来预测性能上的代价。 任务差异仍然存在：JRS LR 在 TOPIC-CLS 和 POS-TAG 上领先，而 LIHS LR 在 MBPP 和 LCB 上领先。 这些差异可能反映了用于估计雅可比矩阵的语料库与词元选择方式，如何塑造了 JRS 保留的与任务相关的信息。 变换这一语料库、词表大小和层范围，可以评估对这些选择的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: J-lens readouts are essentially decoded internal layer activations. Consequently, while some may support failure characterisation, fundamentally they lack any self-reflective diagnosis capabilities. For example, we observe that J-lens readouts correctly point to dynamic programming as the approach towards the solution for MBPP , only to fail to generate a correct implementation. Further studies are required to explore whether self-diagnostic prompting can elicit deeper characterisation.
paragraphs.zh: J-lens 读出本质上是经过解码的内部层激活。 因此，尽管某些读出可以支持失败表征分析，但从根本上说，它们缺乏任何自我反思式的诊断能力。 例如，我们观察到 J-lens 读出能正确指出动态规划是解决 MBPP 问题的方法，却无法生成正确的实现。 自我诊断提示能否引发更深层次的表征分析，仍需进一步研究探索。

paragraphs.en: Component profiles characterise failure groups through prominent tokens, while individual readouts can suggest alternative interpretations of inputs or task specifications. These descriptions come at the extra extraction cost reported in Section 5.5 . Readouts could also characterise LIHS-fitted groups; whether fitting in JRS yields more coherent groups remains untested. Our descriptive interpretation is limited to a few cases. Future studies, potentially involving human users, should assess whether readouts help analysts characterise failures and revise task prompts beyond what inputs and generated responses alone support.
paragraphs.zh: 组件画像通过显著词元来刻画失败组，而单个读出结果可能暗示对输入或任务规范的替代性解读。 这些描述带来了第 5.5 节所报告的额外提取成本。 读出结果也可用于刻画 LIHS 拟合得到的组；在 JRS 中进行拟合是否能产生更连贯的组仍有待检验。 我们的描述性解读仅限于少数几个案例。 未来的研究（可能涉及人类用户）应当评估：除了仅凭输入和生成的回答所能提供的支持之外，读出结果能否帮助分析师刻画失败并修订任务提示。

paragraphs.en: Concept-level test coverage. Foreword characterises groups of failing inputs through their prominent readout tokens. Such group-level summaries may obscure the multiple concepts within an individual input, as the Airbus article illustrates (Section 5.3.2 ). Future work could jointly identify shared concepts and overlapping groups of inputs, allowing an input to belong to several groups. Concept combinations could then serve as discrete, interpretable units of test coverage. Testers could prioritise combinations associated with frequent failures and generate inputs for combinations poorly represented in the test set. Defining the relevant concept space and establishing criteria for adequate coverage remain open questions.
paragraphs.zh: 概念层面的测试覆盖。 前言通过突出的读出词元来刻画失败输入组。 正如 Airbus 文章所示（第 5.3.2 节），这种组级别的摘要可能掩盖单个输入中的多个概念。 未来的工作可以联合识别共享概念与相互重叠的输入组，从而允许一个输入属于多个组。 概念组合随后可以作为离散、可解释的测试覆盖单元。 测试人员可以优先处理与频繁失败相关的概念组合，并为测试集中代表性不足的概念组合生成输入。 如何定义相关的概念空间以及如何确立充分覆盖的判据，仍是悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Threats to internal validity concern anything that could interfere with the observed effect of Foreword , namely its predictive and characterising power. JRS depends on subsets of tokens the LLM is ready to verbalise, hence we cannot rule out possibilities that certain tokens are correlated with failures without actually causing them. We try to minimise such threats by presenting the actual readout tokens in RQ3 for a qualitative analysis. However, only a full understanding of LLM internals can fundamentally rid us of such threats. External validity lies on the degree of generalisation of the reported results. Our study primarily reports on J-lenses for three 8-9B open weight LLMs, against ten tasks; similarly, the transfer study only concerns three proprietary models. Other architectures, such as reasoning models, may produce different Jacobian workspaces, resulting in different results. RQ2 also operationalises distribution shift using other tasks’ inputs placed into the target prompt; such inputs may be easier to detect than drift encountered in deployment. Only further experimentation can reduce threats to external validity. Finally, threats to construct validity concerns whether we are measuring what we intend to observe. We use established measures (ROC-AUC, Failure@ N N , FPR95), as well as scikit-learn implementations that have withstood public scrutiny, to mitigate threats. However, these measures fundamentally remain proxies.

paragraphs.en: We propose Foreword , a pre-generation test adequacy framework for LLMs that learns from both passing and failing reference inputs. Foreword represents each input either as hidden states or as vocabulary-aligned J-lens readouts. Across ten tasks and three open-weight LLMs, Foreword outperforms Clotho, the existing state-of-the-art pre-generation adequacy metric. The LR probe performs the best for failure prediction, with the average ROC-AUC 0.84 over 0.68 of Clotho; the dual GMM provides a reference density, which can flag out-of-distribution inputs with much lower false positive rates than LR. Most importantly, dual GMMs can group failures that share the same confusion; further, J-lens readouts can characterise those failures semantically. Finally, scores computed on small models transfer to larger and proprietary targets, raising normalised failure@ 25 % 25\% from 0.48 to 0.60, allowing testers to prioritise inputs for expensive models before querying them. In future work, we plan to build on these concept-level groupings to measure concept-level test coverage and to generate inputs for poorly covered concept combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Foreword，一个面向大语言模型的生成前测试充分性框架，它能同时从通过和失败的参考输入中学习。 Foreword 将每个输入表示为隐藏状态，或表示为与词表对齐的 J-lens 读出。 在十项任务和三个开放权重大语言模型上，Foreword 的表现优于现有最先进的生成前充分性度量 Clotho。 LR 探针在失败预测上表现最佳，平均 ROC-AUC 为 0.84，高于 Clotho 的 0.68；双 GMM 提供了参考密度，能够以远低于 LR 的误报率标记分布外输入。 最重要的是，双 GMM 能够对共享相同混淆的失败进行分组；此外，J-lens 读出可以从语义上刻画这些失败。 最后，在小模型上计算的分数可以迁移到更大和专有的目标模型上，将归一化 failure@25% 从 0.48 提升到 0.60，使测试者能够在查询昂贵模型之前优先安排输入。 在未来的工作中，我们计划基于这些概念级分组来度量概念级测试覆盖率，并为覆盖不佳的概念组合生成输入。
